description:
Detect procdump, comsvcs.dll minidump, or direct LSASS access

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_execution_execution_140", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lsass%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%memory%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_execution_execution_140", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lsass%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%memory%') AND "value" > 0
